artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: New pure module, no I/O. Exports orderSummaries(texts, openFirst): a permutation of the indices with matching summaries first. Checked by AC1 (arms A1-A7) and by the walk's own use in exploreScope (AC2).

Adds the repeatable --open-first option (parsed beside the other options, usage comment updated) and rewrites the closed-summary loop of exploreScope() to use orderSummaries(), click by fresh text match, and log OPEN-FIRST opened or not found. Without --open-first the clicks are the same as before. Exercised by one real walk (AC2): OPEN-FIRST opened on SHOP CN-Model with 193 visible rows, DISARMED, walk void no.
One paragraph documenting --open-first and its two log lines, beside the --day paragraph.
